description: Read Hacker News items (stories, comments, jobs), user profiles, the top/new/best/Ask/Show/job story listings and a story's comments, and post comments or replies on news.ycombinator.com in your current tab. Every tool parses Hacker News' own server-rendered pages from that tab (its CSP allows no cross-origin API), using your own logged-in session.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get a Hacker News item (story, comment, or job) by its numeric ID with title, URL, HTML text, score, author, timestamp and comment count.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get a Hacker News user profile by username (case-sensitive): karma, account creation date and bio.

tools.name: list_top_stories
tools.description: Get the current top stories from the Hacker News front page, 30 per page, ranked by the HN algorithm. Use page for pagination.

tools.name: list_new_stories
tools.description: Get the newest Hacker News stories, most recent first, 30 per page. Use page for pagination.

tools.name: list_best_stories
tools.description: Get the best (historically high-performing) Hacker News stories, 30 per page. Use page for pagination.

tools.name: list_ask_stories
tools.description: Get the latest Ask HN stories — questions posted by the community for discussion — 30 per page. Use page for pagination.

tools.name: list_show_stories
tools.description: Get the latest Show HN stories — projects and products shared by the community — 30 per page. Use page for pagination.

tools.name: list_job_stories
tools.description: Get the latest Hacker News job postings, 30 per page. Use page for pagination.

tools.name: get_story_comments
tools.description: Get a Hacker News story's comments in ranked display order with nesting depth (indent 0 = top-level), plus the total comment count and whether more comment pages exist.

tools.name: submit_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a Hacker News story or reply to an existing comment. Requires being logged in; parent_id is a story ID for a top-level comment or a comment ID for a reply. Submits the site's own multipart comment form with the page's HMAC token.
